content: Expo SDK 57.0.13 is the stable family. Its official template pins React 19.2.3, React Native 0.86.2, TypeScript ~6.0.3, New Architecture, and Hermes. A clean prebuild generated Gradle 9.3.1, AGP 8.12.0, Kotlin 2.1.20, API 36, minSdk 24, Build Tools 36.0.0, and NDK 27.1.12297006. Node 24.19.0 LTS satisfies RN engines; pin Node/npm and assert generated Android internals rather than overriding them.
